title: Pass existing dev JWT verifier settings to Research reads
environment: worker test interpreter via scripts/dev/provision_python_distribution.py (.venv-pantheon/bin/python3); task worktree cwd; configuration source delivery only; no VM/SSH, product credentials, or hosted deployment actions

source_finding_reference.classification: Current dev deployment configuration omission for an existing verifier; no new auth capability

ac_1_pass_dev_bff_jwt_verifier_settings_.detail: Mapped PANTHEON_RESEARCH_AUTH_MODE, PANTHEON_RESEARCH_JWT_SECRET, PANTHEON_RESEARCH_JWT_ISSUER, and PANTHEON_RESEARCH_JWT_AUDIENCE into services.research-orchestrator-svc.environment in docker-compose.yml so services.deployment.auth.service_auth_env('RESEARCH') and authenticate_tenant(..., service_prefix='RESEARCH') receive the configured verification mode, secret, issuer, and audience when authenticating BFF-forwarded callers.

ac_2_reuse_canonical_aliases_and_preserv.detail: Chained PANTHEON_RESEARCH_AUTH_MODE -> PANTHEON_BFF_AUTH_MODE -> PANTHEON_DEV_BFF_AUTH_MODE -> strict, and PANTHEON_RESEARCH_JWT_{SECRET,ISSUER,AUDIENCE} -> PANTHEON_BFF_JWT_{SECRET,ISSUER,AUDIENCE} -> PANTHEON_DEV_BFF_JWT_{SECRET,ISSUER,AUDIENCE} -> empty. Preserves service-specific PANTHEON_RESEARCH_* overrides, supports scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh with_dev_bff_runtime_env (PANTHEON_BFF_*) and canonical PANTHEON_DEV_BFF_* aliases including non-default issuer and audience, and introduces no hardcoded credentials, live secret values, secret files, rotation, issuers, grants, MFA, or new auth services.

ac_3_confine_changes_to_research_compose.detail: Production diff is confined strictly to 4 environment lines in services.research-orchestrator-svc.environment in docker-compose.yml (+4/-0 lines). All other services, images, ports, volumes, egress settings, and paper/live boundaries are untouched. Parallel Research reader source (BFF-RESEARCH-ARTIFACT-OWNER-READ-20261020), Tools/Skills, and PM12 source files are untouched.

ac_4_validate_compose_render_and_verifie.detail: Validated effective docker compose --profile root config render with placeholder secrets and non-default issuer/audience across (1) PANTHEON_BFF_* runtime injection, (2) PANTHEON_DEV_BFF_* canonical alias fallback, and (3) PANTHEON_RESEARCH_* service-specific override precedence, and verified that service_auth_env('RESEARCH') and authenticate_tenant(..., service_prefix='RESEARCH') enforce the bound mode, secret presence, issuer, audience, and tenant claims without printing secret values.

ac_5_clean_task_branch_and_source_only_d.detail: Delivered on clean task/DEV-RESEARCH-READ-JWT-BINDING-20261020 branch with scoped artifacts only (docker-compose.yml and docs/deployment/evidence/DEV-RESEARCH-READ-JWT-BINDING-20261020/evidence.json) for independent exact-head review, CI, and native dev integration.

ac_6_coordinator_retains_joined_release_.detail: No separate deployment or release controller action was performed; the original coordinator owns the joined exact-pair dev release, post-deploy configuration presence verification, and hosted operator/viewer readback and auth/tenant negative checks.

validation.command: .venv-pantheon/bin/python3 -c "<docker compose --profile root --env-file /dev/null -f docker-compose.yml config --format json + service_auth_env('RESEARCH') + authenticate_tenant(..., service_prefix='RESEARCH') with placeholder secret and non-default issuer/audience across BFF injection, DEV_BFF alias, and RESEARCH override>"
validation.result: verified effective_auth_mode=strict, effective_JWT_secret_present=true, non-default issuer/audience binding, override precedence, and 401 AUTH_JWT_ISSUER_MISMATCH / AUTH_JWT_AUDIENCE_MISMATCH negatives without printing secret values
